title: FreKoo++: Learning Continuous Spectral Dynamics for Temporal Domain Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2608.22224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Temporal Domain Generalization (TDG) aims to learn from historical domains and generalize to unseen future distributions under concept drift. Nevertheless, prevailing TDG methods struggle with complex real-world streaming scenarios involving both multi-scale drift patterns (e.g., long-term periodicity intertwined with short-term incremental changes) and local uncertainties, especially in continuous settings where observations arrive irregularly. To address this limitation, we propose FreKoo++, a novel continuous spectral-dynamical framework that pioneers the unification of continuous Koopman modal dynamics with adaptive spectral disentanglement. Specifically, FreKoo++ maps source-domain parameters into a compact latent space, modeling their evolution as a superposition of learnable continuous modes where complex eigenvalues jointly encode oscillatory frequency and temporal growth or decay. translated_title: FreKoo++：学习连续频谱动力学用于时间域泛化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22224v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：时间域泛化（TDG）旨在从历史域中学习，并在概念漂移下泛化到未见过的未来分布。然而，现有的TDG方法在处理复杂的现实世界流式场景时面临困难，这些场景涉及多尺度漂移模式（例如，长期周期性与短期增量变化交织）和局部不确定性，尤其是在观测不规则到达的连续设置中。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了FreKoo++，一种新颖的连续频谱-动力学框架，开创性地将连续Koopman模态动力学与自适应频谱解缠相结合。具体而言，FreKoo++将源域参数映射到一个紧凑的潜空间中，将其演化建模为可学习连续模态的叠加，其中复特征值共同编码振荡频率和时间增长或衰减。这种表述自然适应不规则观测。
tldr: FreKoo++通过结合连续Koopman模态动力学和自适应频谱解缠，提出了一种能有效处理多尺度漂移模式和不规则观测的连续频谱动力学框架，从而提升了时间域泛化的性能。
en_tdlr: FreKoo++ proposes a continuous spectral-dynamical framework that integrates continuous Koopman modal dynamics with adaptive spectral disentanglement, effectively handling multi-scale drift patterns and irregular observations to improve temporal domain generalization.
